verdict.rationale: RustDesk's first-party docs state that Server Pro adds a web console, device groups, a shared address book, and per-user and device-group access control. The pricing page lists Web console, Address book and Access control as plan features. A community comment that only paid Pro has authentication is consistent with this being a commercial-tier capability, not a contradiction. Missing for 10: the capability is limited to the paid Server Pro tier (not the OSS server), there are no in-depth docs on how group policies are configured, and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration of the address book or group access-control features.
